name: Bitcoin
source: Snapshot of daily BTC/USD closes compiled 2026-11-18 from the Bitstamp public OHLC API (step=86400). Bundled at build time / GitHub Actions. Not a live data feed and not for trading.
termsNote: Educational dated snapshot with attribution. The browser never calls Bitstamp. Commercial redistribution of Bitstamp exchange data may require a Data License Agreement (partners@bitstamp.net). Coinbase was not used: its Market Data Terms of Use forbid displaying or redistributing that market data to third parties without prior written consent. CoinGecko and Binance are not used.
